chapter_seo_title: How Ji Ning's Thirty Percent Gamble Reveals a Fiendgod's Clone
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning demonstrates Sword Light Flashes, then challenges the War God Hall's third level against a golden-armored Fiendgod clone—discovering a secret far deeper than he expected.
og_title: The War God Hall's Third Level Hides a Fiendgod Clone
og_description: After half a month of Dao epiphany, Ji Ning uses his only remaining attempt to face a general made from a sliver of divine power. Will he survive?
twitter_title: Ji Ning vs. a Fiendgod Clone – 30% Odds, 100% Drama
twitter_description: The War God Hall third level isn't what Ji Ning expected. A golden-armored general formed from a sliver of divine power awaits. The Water Mansion's secret just got bigger.

lore_anchors.definition: A nine-stance sword art created by Immortal Beixing, the mightiest Sword Immortal in Black-White College's history. Its third stance, Sword Light Flashes, leaves a visible trail in the air.
The third stance of the Three-Foot Sword, described as a restrained yet brilliant stroke that leaves a visible afterimage like a painter's brushstroke.
A trial tower within the Water Mansion created by Daoist Threelives. Each level contains a unique challenge; passing grants access to greater divine abilities and treasures.
A Fiendgod technique where a sliver of divine power is used to create an independent fighting form. Only Fiendgods at the Void God level or above can sustain such a clone with autonomous will.
The artifact spirit of the Water Mansion, created by Daoist Threelives. He oversees the War God Hall trials and speaks with ancient, impartial authority.
The artifact spirit of Celestial Immortal Juhua's Immortal-ranked treasure. Loyal to Juhua's legacy and often defensive of his master's reputation.
The Sword Immortal who created the Three-Foot Sword. A Loose Immortal who lived over a million years, surpassing Celestial Immortal Juhua in talent according to Yellow Bear.
The original owner of the Water Mansion who failed to unlock its deepest secrets. An Earth Immortal turned Loose Immortal who could not pass the War God Hall's seventh level.
